claim_one_line: THE RENDER AUDIT (cc3 handoff, processed integrate-don't-merge). THE HEADLINE IS THE PROCESS POINT, NOT THE DEFECTS: C1 and C2 were latent in code that had ALREADY produced banked results and passed three section-16 review passes, a shakedown, and 58 hours of certified computation -- and NEITHER surfaced while computing, because a number off by a phase still looks like a number and a truncated-but-sufficient move set produces exactly the right answer, while BOTH surfaced within an hour of somebody trying to DRAW the output. ADOPTED as a practices row: for any arc whose product is a FIELD, a SPECTRUM or a SET OF POINTS, render it once BEFORE banking -- not for presentation, as a CHECK. This is the exact complement to today's two new gates: lawmap-scope and retraction-sweep catch CLAIM DRIFT IN PROSE, rendering catches STRUCTURE DRIFT IN NUMBERS, the class the numerics absorb silently. It is NOT gateable ('did you render it' cannot be checked automatically), so it is a human obligation recorded as such. C1 DOCSTRING OVERCLAIM, ACCEPTED and bounded by cc3's own control: build_moves(maxlen=5) documents itself as returning all |c| <= 2.2 but returns only words of length <= 5 (91 of them; <=6 gives 143, <=7 gives 207) -- and cc3 bounded it rather than asserting harmlessness, re-running the pullback with the <=5 and <=7 sets over 120 sample points for 0 differing points and max difference 0.00e+00, BIT-IDENTICAL, because ascent needs only A height-raising element and the extra 116 are alternative routes to the same maximum. No banked eigenvalue affected; fix is one docstring line. C2 GLOBAL-PHASE CONTAMINATION, ACCEPTED, AND B940 CHECKED HERE: the collocation eigenvector comes from an SVD fixed only up to a global phase and nothing pins it (measured theta = +40.20, +148.92, -26.55 degrees for lambda1, lambda2 and the parent, with Re-contamination up to 96%). NOTHING IS FALSE -- both Re f and Im f solve the eigenvalue equation -- the defect is REPRODUCIBILITY, since a re-run gives a different rotation and any pointwise use of Re/Im separately is meaningless without the pin. IS THE SEALED DIRAC RUN AFFECTED? NO, and with a reason rather than a hope: every sealed element is phase-INVARIANT -- the two-Y bar, two seeds, P4 spread, P3 control and +/- partner are statements about LAMBDA; G1 is a RELATIVE residual of D psi = lambda psi, and under psi -> e^{i theta} psi both sides scale together so it is unchanged; G2/G2b concern the representation; the assembly cross-check compares matrix rows; and the kernel and doubling records are SINGULAR VALUES -- while the .real uses in dirac_sealed.py are all lattice/trace/mode-label quantities, with no eigenfunction real part ever taken. B940 STANDS. The PROSPECTIVE warning stands and is banked: if B940 is ever extended to use eigenfunction POINTWISE values (a density, an overlap, a real form) THE PHASE MUST BE PINNED FIRST, exactly as cc3 flagged for the B804 spinor extension. C3 A TOLERANCE ERROR IN A FINDING'S OWN FAVOUR, VERIFIED HERE: the Plate-E agent asserted all 36 horoball radii = 1/(2N) with N an Eisenstein norm and its OWN assertion then flagged 97, 91, 84 as exceptions, at a 1e-9 tolerance against snappy's ~1e-8 output -- checked on this bench with N = a^2 - ab + b^2, all three ARE Eisenstein norms (97 = 3^2-3(-8)+(-8)^2; 91 = 1^2-1(-9)+(-9)^2; 84 = 2^2-2(-8)+(-8)^2), so THE FINDING STANDS and the tolerance was the error. The finding is genuinely new: THE ARITHMETIC OF Q(sqrt-3) IS VISIBLE AS THE SIZES OF THE SPHERES IN THE CUSP PACKING, and no computation on that branch had asked for it. Error class: a correct result partially SELF-REFUTED by a numerical tolerance chosen tighter than the data's own precision -- close to E31 (instrument precondition unchecked) but aimed at the ASSERTION rather than the instrument; recorded as an E31 instance with that distinction noted rather than a new class, since one instance does not earn a class. C4 THE PLATE, DECIDED: ACCEPT the rename to PLATE J -- THE NULL, since cc3 verified its numbers against the sealed run (2+39 = 41 candidates, 0 gated; p = 0.994/0.962/0.856/0.526/0.242; PSLQ null rate 0.00) and it shows the object at the 51st PERCENTILE OF NOISE -- keep it and label it honestly, because an atlas that only shows the hits is a brochure. And GO on PLATE I -- THE WALL (B736), the programme's sharpest POSITIVE no-go, which the atlas lacks.
